meta.name: resource-rate-monitor
meta.author: Skrip
meta.description:
Monitor your resource rate changes in real time.

Features:
- Color-coded rate display: [#8585FF]gaining[], [red]losing[], [white]stable[]
- [red](!)[] Low-stock warning when a resource is under 10 seconds from depletion
- [yellow]Flicker detection[] for resources being consumed as fast as they arrive (~00)
- Click the resource table to cycle column count (4-8)
- Compact number formatting (1.5k, 2.3M, etc.)
